analysisSummary: With heat_pump_dryer frozen, the minimum stable AIO contract is composition-based: front_load_washer (wash) + frozen heat_pump_dryer references (HP thermal + shared moisture rejection) + one new AIO-owned thermal sibling (condenser_resistive_dry_heat) + one AIO-only integration function (integrated_laundry_orchestration). sealed_ventless_drying parent REJECTED — descriptive umbrella without independent diagnostic responsibility. sealed_heat_pump_drying SUPERSEDED — must not generalize Whirlpool resistive condenser path.

A_sealed_moisture_rejection_path_shared.rationale: Both W1 and W2 reject vented_dryer exhaust_path terminal; both use sealed ventless condensation-based moisture rejection. Function was frozen in HP dryer as modality-neutral moisture domain — not HP-exclusive.

B_sealed_ventless_drying_parent_necessar.rationale: Parent adds no diagnostic responsibility beyond union of (a) modality-specific thermal functions and (b) shared moisture path. Fault families already split: no-heat localizes to heat_pump_thermal_system OR condenser_resistive_dry_heat; condensate/float localizes to sealed_moisture_rejection_path. Parent would be organizational only.

C_condenser_resistive_sufficiently_neutr.rationale: Names heat-generation responsibility (resistive dry heat on sealed condenser/recirculating air path) — distinct from vented_dryer heat_source primary contract and from heat_pump_thermal_system. Whirlpool W2 is witness; naming describes mechanism class not OEM topology.
